Try an answer, choose **Check**, and use **Feedback** if you need a next step.
Open the source beneath the activity to change the equation for your students.

**Feedback** prepares a message to paste into an AI chat. If your course has
feedback set up on the page, you can receive the reply here instead.


## Solve an equation

Subtract the same quantity from both sides to keep an equation balanced.

```{math-exercise}
#| label: equation
For $3x+2=14$, enter $x=$ _[4].
```

Choose Check to test your answer, then Feedback for progressively more help.
